1.consolidated_definition: Pez de mar, comestible, perteneciente a la familia del atún. Su descripción corresponde bastante a la del pez vaca.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish, edible, belonging to the tuna family. Its description is quite similar to that of the cowfish.
